newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares end quiet week slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares end quiet week slightly firmer.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market ended the week to Thursday slightly firmer in quiet year-end trade, dealers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose 14 points to 2,486.93 from 2,472.53. The index had fallen 2.5 points the previous week.
Shares of seven stocks rose and the rest were steady.

The biggest gainer was Commercial Bank of Dubai whose shares climbed to 58 dirhams from 53. NBAD and Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank shares were also five dirhams firmer, closing at 445 and 345 dirhams respectively.
Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company gathered another five dirhams to 1,050.
Emirates Insurance Company was flat at 620 dirhams.
